Name: Whimsical Girl
Author: onlyonechris
Description:
[b][size=3][color=#ff7700]*MAJOR UPDATE*[/color]
[color=#ff7700]1.6 Adds more sleeves, Fairy wings, Feather wings, Nose options and Ear options! [/color]
[/size][/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8199]
[/url]Changes your female *not gendered, just the selection made when creating the character.*  farmer sleeves with the weather, season and randomly at the start of each day within seasonal choices. 

I was building this mod when Dynamic Sleeves dropped so I abandoned it for a while as I thought DS had it covered. But I realized what I was missing most is the ability to randomly switch sleeve styles throughout the days rather than only changing on seasons. I also wanted to be sure I was in certain clothes for rainy days.

* * *   INSTRUCTIONS   * * *

- Install the latest versions of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
- Download this mod, unzip it, and place the '[CP] Whimsical Girl" folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
- Run the game once to generate a config.json file.
- Edit the config.json file with the configuration options you choose. I personally leave it on Random as that is the seasonal options on a random rotation.[/color][/url][/size][/b]
